message: Send a URL to AlterLab and get clean, structured data back.

personas.name: Platform engineer
personas.description: Builds data pipelines that need clean, structured pages from the web.

personas.name: Product lead
personas.description: Ships features on top of web data without an in-house scraping team.

audience.prior_knowledge: Has written or maintained a scraper and knows how often they break.
objections: Will it keep working when sites change?

proof_points.claim: One API turns any web page into clean, structured data.
Teams send a URL and get structured results back.

tone: Clear, precise and calm; the product interface is the hero.
success_measure: Viewers start a free AlterLab account.
